none: PAS CAM-6CDAE5: Roman Coin : Copper alloy Nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Nummus of the House of Constantine (Reece period 17). Reverse legend is illegible. Reverse: Victory on prow. Mint is Lyons, AD 330-331. RIC, VII, p138, no241. Obverse legend reads: [CONSTANTINOPOLIS]. Obverse: Helmeted bust of Constantinopolis facing left. Die Axis: 6 o'clock
